entries.note: Chinese wording 快件电子信息已经收到. The waybill's information reached Xingyou, before it has the parcel.
Chinese wording 快件到达作业中心. "The parcel reached the operations centre": the first scan, at Xingyou's site.
Chinese wording 快件操作完成. "Handling of the parcel is complete"; it leaves the site.

entries.wording: Shipment packed and sent to next destination
entries.note: Chinese wording 货物已打包并发送至下一个目的地. "Packed and sent to the next destination".

entries.wording: The shipment is in domestic transit
entries.note: Chinese wording 该货物正在国内转运中. "In transit within China", to the export airport.
Chinese wording 出口海关放行. "Released by export customs".

entries.wording: The shipment has cleared customs and is en route to the airport
entries.note: Chinese wording 货物已通关送往机场. "Cleared and sent to the airport".
Chinese wording 航班起飞. "Flight departed".
Chinese wording 航班抵达. "Flight arrived", at the destination.
Chinese wording 进口清关中. "Import clearance under way".
Chinese wording 目的国清关完成. "Clearance in the destination country completed", before the delivering carrier takes the parcel.
